Hi there! I need some help with a few exchanges and a cancellation from my recent orders. I’d like to swap my kid’s bicycle for one with a larger frame size—switching to a mountain bike is fine. Also, I want to exchange the jigsaw puzzle from the same order for one with the same difficulty but with 1000 more pieces, and I’d prefer an art theme over animals if that’s possible.

Additionally, I’d like to exchange my camera for one with a slightly lower resolution, but I want to keep all the other features the same. For both exchanges, I’d prefer to use my Visa card for any payments or refunds.

Lastly, I want to cancel just the skateboard from one of my orders. Can you help me with all of this?

Yes—I can help, but first I need to authenticate your account.

**Please reply with the email address on your account** (or your **first name + last name + ZIP**).

Also, to make sure I apply the right actions (exchange vs cancellation depends on whether the orders are **pending** or **delivered**), please send:

1) **Order ID for the bicycle exchange** (the kid’s bike → larger frame / mountain bike)  
2) **Order ID for the jigsaw puzzle exchange** (same difficulty; +1000 pieces; art theme vs animals—if available)  
3) **Order ID for the camera exchange** (lower resolution; keep other features)  
4) **Order ID for the skateboard** cancellation request

Once I have your email + those order IDs, I’ll look up each order’s status and items, then I can prepare the exact exchange/cancellation details for your confirmation.

Quick note: our system **can only cancel an entire pending order** (not a single item within an order). If the skateboard order is **delivered**, we can usually do a **return** or an **exchange** instead—I'll confirm after I check the order status.

I actually don’t remember the email I used, but my name is Sofia Li and my zip code is 78260.

I’m a bit cautious about mixing things up, so could you please look up my orders using that info? I don’t have the order IDs handy right now. If you need me to check anything else, just let me know!
